audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart was a blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[0..6] and the packet both read Zed on rows 0-5 and Anivia on row 6.
audit.why: Anivia has no dash and pays 80 mana per Flash Frost at rank 1, so Zed owns the whole laning phase; Rebirth plus Glacial Storm and Zhonya's outlast a 3s mark two items in.
audit.corrected: phases[0..5].side=Zed, phases[6].side=Anivia with phases[6].why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike ignored Rebirth entirely, so the page told you to mark her without saying what the mark has to get through.
audit.why: Rebirth reverts Anivia to an egg at full health on fatal damage, so a lane kill needs Ignite or a second damage string held back.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes and breakdown.mid now name the egg as the thing your burst must clear.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent. Crystallize is an impassable wall that blocks all movement — it walls off the Living Shadow swap and the Death Mark dash. Frostbite only doubles on a target recently hit by Flash Frost or a fully formed Glacial Storm, so dodging the Q halves her burst.
audit.why: Riot text: 'an impassable wall of ice to block all movement'; 'If the target was recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm, the damage they take is doubled.' Zed's W and R both carry the dash flag walls deny.
audit.corrected: Wall-blocks-the-swap stated in tradeBad, breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[1].d; the Frostbite doubling condition stated in breakdown.cooldowns and tradeGood.

audit.why: It is the field that carries real numbers.
audit.corrected: Flash Frost 11s at rank 1 to 7s at rank 5; Crystallize 17s flat.

audit.whatIsWrong: 15 lint findings: 12 misgendered fields calling Anivia he/his/him, 2 copy-paste bleeds, 1 numberless cooldown field.
audit.why: Anivia is female per champ-gender.js; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed and both bleeding bullets rewritten to their own titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: QA pass: matchup-lint and regression-check still reported findings on this matchup after the proposing pass.
